div.div: Boxes are TESPy nodes (power_plant.nodes); arrows are power_plant.edges. Orange = geofluid loop (common.fluid_name), teal = secondary/R245fa loop — the two never mix, only exchange heat at evaporator/preheater.

div.div: circulation_control is PumpOrValve, not a fixed Compressor: whether the geofluid recirculation point needs real work or is a passive throttle depends on whether the loop's natural (thermosiphon) driving pressure already exceeds what's needed — same ambiguity as AGS_direct_heat.yml's circulation_control.
